metadata.description: Curated subset of the frozen NL->FOL screen (Experiment 3, candidate C). One example = one sentence: its text, gold reference FOL, the leave-one-out translation pool (P1..P6 fresh OpenRouter peers + 3 Logic-LM systems), the K=5 self-consistency samples (sc_cheap = gpt-4.1-nano T=0.7, sc_same = gpt-3.5-turbo T=0.7) and the track-L candidates labelled CORRECT/ERROR by prover-checked equivalence to gold (full_run = the original run's scores, for comparison).
metadata.source: FOLIO (validation, curated) + MALLS (test, curated) sentences; candidates from Logic-LM released outputs

planted.note: pipeline check only; never reported as validation
